title: Research candidate contracts, schema contract ladder v0.3

items.description: Exact existing request snapshot; equality is checked when its query branch becomes active. Identity remains an unreviewed candidate.

target_request.description: Exact host-owned request snapshot; additional fields preserve TeX and PDF request shapes. Host equality is mandatory.

SourceCorrectionNotice.description: Discovery-only blocking notice. Host additionally requires distinct work IDs, unique targets, and exact paper, statement, conditions and source-span equality. Work aliases are not automatically equivalent. No impact acceptance or source closure is granted.

RootAudit.description: Root audit written by library.root_audits: lexically ranked declarations of a Lean-built library index. The candidates are neither a binding nor evidence of library absence.

FrozenTextByteSpan.description: Host UTF-8 byte span. End ordering, source hash and exact slice hash require host checks.

CandidateEvidenceLocation.description: Explicit alternatives preserve legacy spans without translating PDF regions into fictitious text offsets. A location never establishes semantic alignment.

CandidateClauseCoverage.description: Candidate coverage of one source clause by this declaration. Clause IDs are local to the bound node. Neither an empty obligations list nor candidate equivalence establishes semantic acceptance or completeness of the node's clause inventory.

clause_coverage.description: Optional clause-level candidate mapping. Missing legacy coverage is unknown, not whole-node coverage. Multiple successful declarations do not prove the source clause inventory is complete.

premise_comparison.description: Optional candidate premise evidence, including structure fields. Does not establish source alignment or authorize proof composition; absence in legacy bindings means unrecorded, not equivalent.

execution_context.description: Host-retained execution isolation and resource evidence; absence carries no isolation assertion.

decision_policy.description: Exploration may schedule unreviewed candidates but cannot promote their scientific status or complete a chain certificate. Omission is strict.

max_proof_attempts.description: Frozen plan-wide reservation cap required before bottom-up proof or premise dispatch.

query_selector.description: Frozen before extraction; the host binds query_ids once. SOURCE_LABELS selects claims located by the query paper's \label occurrences; an unmatched label is a hard failure.

claim_reference_policy.description: Frozen in new plans; absence selects the legacy claim-reference assembly for historical reconstruction.

content.description: The reviewed content as review.py template showed it; subject_sha256 is its canonical digest. Informational: the host recomputes the digest.

PDFPageRegion.description: Binds document/page/image bytes and region geometry only; not exact text or accepted mathematics. Rectangle ordering and page-image correspondence are host obligations.
